headline: Power & Instrumentation holds 42nd AGM, adopts ESOP scheme
summary: Power & Instrumentation (Gujarat) Ltd held its 42nd AGM on September 25, 2026. Key resolutions included adopting the PIGL ESOP Scheme 2026 and ratifying auditor appointments.

headline: Sharika Enterprises Allots 1.21 Cr Shares
summary: Sharika Enterprises Limited allotted 1.21 crore equity shares and 28.12 lakh warrants on a preferential basis, raising ₹17.47 crore in fresh capital.

headline: Lakshya Powertech wins Rs 276.37 Cr O&M order from Vedanta
summary: Lakshya Powertech secures a confirmed Rs 276.37 crore work order for O&M services. This large order significantly boosts the backlog, though negative operating cashflow in FY26 warrants monitoring of working capital efficiency.

headline: Supriya Lifescience AGM concludes with all resolutions passed
summary: Supriya Lifescience Limited held its 18th AGM on September 24, 2026. All five ordinary resolutions, including the final dividend and director reappointments, were passed with requisite majority.

headline: Tata Chemicals swaps KPMG for KNAV in UK units
summary: Tata Chemicals replaces KPMG LLP with KNAV Limited as statutory auditor for four UK subsidiaries, citing fee disputes. The change affects holding and operating entities including British Salt.

headline: SBEC Sugar closes trading window for Q2FY27 results
summary: SBEC Sugar Ltd has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, until 48 hours after the declaration of Q2FY27 financial results.

headline: Motherson issues ₹300 crore CP at 6.25%
summary: Samvardhana Motherson International issued ₹300 crore commercial paper with a 64-day tenure. The unsecured debt carries a 6.25% interest rate and matures on November 27, 2026.

headline: Shayona Engineering closes trading window
summary: Shayona Engineering Ltd. has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, until 48 hours after declaring H1FY27 results.

headline: Anmol India passes all AGM resolutions
summary: Anmol India Limited held its 28th Annual General Meeting on September 26, 2026. All resolutions mentioned in the notice were passed with the requisite majority.

headline: Centrum Capital promoter pledges more shares
summary: Business Match Services pledged additional Centrum Capital shares to Minsol and STCI Finance due to market price fluctuations, raising total encumbered holding to 9.43%.

headline: Kanani Industries closes trading window for Q2FY27 results
summary: Kanani Industries Ltd has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, for the approval of Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results. The window will reopen 48 hours after the declaration of the unaudited financial results.

headline: Craft Emerging Market Fund acquires 5.79% in Jindal Supreme
summary: Craft Emerging Market Fund PCC acquired 29.53 lakh shares of Jindal Supreme India Ltd via IPO anchor investment, taking its stake to 5.79%. The acquisition was disclosed under SEBI SAST regulations on September 22, 2026.

headline: Arman Financial closes trading window for Q2FY27
summary: Arman Financial Services Limited has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, ahead of the submission of un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Vivek Raheja sells 2.29% stake in Sabrimala Industries
summary: Vivek Raheja and Persons Acting in Concert sold 2,00,000 equity shares of Sabrimala Industries India Ltd in the open market, reducing their aggregate holding to 4.18%.

headline: Onelife converts warrants in Swojas Foods
summary: Onelife Capital Advisors converted 24.25 lakh equity share warrants into shares of Swojas Foods, raising its voting rights holding to 15%.

headline: United Textiles closes trading window for Q2FY27
summary: United Textiles Limited has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, ahead of Q2FY27 results. The window remains shut until two days after the board declares unaudited financials.

headline: Ultramarine closes trading window for Q2FY27 results
summary: Ultramarine & Pigments Ltd has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, ahead of the declaration of unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ending September 30, 2026.

headline: Sixth Sense cuts Parag Milk stake to 2.69%
summary: Sixth Sense India Opportunities III sold 29,54,115 shares of Parag Milk Foods, reducing its holding to 2.69% and triggering a 2% shareholding change.

headline: Birla Capital & Financial Services AGM approves FY26 financials
summary: Birla Capital and Financial Services Limited concluded its 40th AGM, approving FY26 financial statements and appointing key directors and auditors.

headline: Sirohia & Sons adopts FY26 financials at 36th AGM
summary: Sirohia & Sons Ltd held its 36th AGM on September 26, 2026, adopting audited FY26 financials and reappointing Rajat Sirohia as director.

headline: Mehul Telecom opens new retail store in Ahmedabad
summary: Mehul Telecom Limited opened a new franchise retail store in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on September 26, 2026. The store is located at Murtimant Shopping & Office Complex.

headline: Nutech Global closes trading window for Q2FY27 results
summary: Nutech Global Ltd has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, until 48 hours after declaring Q2FY27 financial results, per SEBI insider trading norms.

headline: Ravinder Heights concludes 7th AGM with two resolutions
summary: Ravinder Heights Limited held its 7th Annual General Meeting on September 26, 2026. Members approved standalone and consolidated financial statements for FY26 and the re-appointment of director Radhika Jain.
